claude_protection_detail:
Locks the current node and routing mode (rule or global), enables TUN, strict routing, IPv6 handling, UDP, broad rules, encrypted DNS and live blocking of unexpected connections, then closes current core connections so apps can reconnect. Protection cannot start with DIRECT as the global exit; direct mode switches to rule mode.

These settings may affect other apps, local websites and private network services. DNS lookups may fail if the node fails. Node domains use the original node DNS locally; public domains use encrypted DNS through the protected node, while local network names remain locally resolved.

The previous proxy mode, DNS, UDP, rules and node selection are saved across restarts and restored when protection is disabled.

Protection cannot eliminate every regional signal or guarantee account eligibility.
